onboarding.choose.title: Welcome to {brand}
onboarding.choose.intro: {brand} sees what you are working on and suggests entries that you confirm. Raw activity never leaves your computer.
onboarding.choose.cloud_body: The same data and timer as on the web, in the extension and on mobile. Included in every plan, even Free.
onboarding.choose.local_body: No account. Your data stays here only. Lifetime license for {price}, or try it for free.
onboarding.login.title: Log in in the browser
onboarding.login.text: We have opened {brand} in your browser. Log in there and approve this computer. You will then come back here automatically.
onboarding.login.waiting_label: Waiting for the login from the browser
onboarding.login.waiting: Waiting for the login from the browser …
onboarding.login.paste_text: Copy the link from the browser page "Open {brand}" and paste it here.
onboarding.local.title: Use {brand} locally
onboarding.local.text: Everything is stored on this computer. You can always move your data up to {brand} later with one click.
onboarding.perm.title: Give {brand} access
onboarding.perm.text: macOS asks for two permissions. They are only used for suggestions on this computer. Nothing is sent on.
onboarding.perm.ax_why: So the app can see which program and window you are working in, and read the address in your browser.
onboarding.perm.screen_why: So the window title can be read, e.g. the name of the document. No images or video are ever recorded.
onboarding.perm.without: Without the permissions the app only sees the program name. You can grant them later.
onboarding.perm.automation_note: The first time you use a browser, macOS also asks whether {brand} may control it. This is only used to read the page address, and you can turn it off under Settings → Tracking.
onboarding.demo.confirmed_body: This is how a suggestion becomes an entry. You can confirm a whole day at once.
onboarding.demo.corrected_body: When you correct, the app learns the pattern. Next time the suggestion will fit better.
onboarding.demo.rejected_body: Rejected suggestions disappear. Nothing is recorded until you say yes.
onboarding.demo.title: What a suggestion looks like
onboarding.demo.text: The app gathers your activity into blocks and suggests who the time belongs to. Try the buttons. This is only a demo.
onboarding.demo.card_label: Suggestion: 09:00-11:00 The Corner Bakery, New webshop
onboarding.import.title: Move my local data to {brand}
onboarding.import.text: Have you used {brand} locally on this computer? Then you can move customers, projects, entries and punch cards up to your account. Run a trial first. It changes nothing.
